Jet black short hair with a sharp fringe and a disciplined texture. Deep amber almond-shaped eyes with a stern, focused expression. Appears to be in the early twenties with a mature, sharp facial structure. Lean, athletic build wearing a dark navy and charcoal grey tactical uniform with metallic accents. Features a distinctive pair of black animal ears protruding from the crown of the head and a long, slender black feline tail.
BODY COLOR: pale beige
